text:
Anika: Quick share from user tests 1: people click the onboarding banner but expect a checklist immediately, not just a rail.
Sam: same in lab. Rail is low-friction but users miss the checklist affordance. Modal forces a flow but blocks exploration.
Raj: FYI metrics: trial->active dipped after the rail-only rollout. CTA copy might be ambiguous.
Julia: accessibility nits: rail CTA contrast 3.8:1 (fails AA). Keyboard focus skips rail CTA. Need tabindex + contrast fixes.
Anika: copy candidates to A/B: "Create demo project", "Follow setup checklist", "Try a sample stack". I prefer explicit.
Sam: +1 explicit. Add one-line microcopy under CTA: "Sandbox with sample prompts  2 minutes."
Raj: sticky preference needed for Dedicated users if we open modal; save choice in profile so we don't nag returning users.
Julia: a11y quick fixes: role="region" + aria-label on rail, visible focus ring, single-Tab reachability, and contrast >=4.5:1. CSS suggestion:
```
.rail-cta { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-color); color: #07204a; }
```
DesignBot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/onboard-entry-rail (v4) 1: includes contrast and two copy variants.
Anika: proposed decision: keep rail by default but add an inline 3-bullet preview (Invite teammates; Deploy sample app; Run a test prompt). Add a "Full setup" link to open the modal checklist.
Sam: hybrid seems promising. Telemetry events: entry_rail_cta_click, entry_preview_expand, entry_flyout_open, entry_rail_dismiss.
Raj: experiment rule: if user dismisses rail, hide for 14 days. Track dismiss_count.
Julia: I'll attach keyboard-nav spec, voiceover notes, and contrast screenshots to the ticket.
Sam: eng estimate ~3 days (copy + contrast + tabindex + telemetry). Flyout already exists.
Anika: if under 2 days we try for next sprint, otherwise following sprint. I'll wait for ticket and experiment plan. Thanks :thumbsup:
